_comment: Maegu skill database. 'command' is the DEFAULT-hotkey activation (as guides write it); the render tool transposes it to Jon's keys via data/keybinds/account.json. 'icon' is a filename under assets/skills/maegu/ (embedded as a data URI when present). Populated from the Netherax [Fox] Maegu guide + BDFoundry; expand as needed.

skills.name: Flower Shroud
skills.note: Movement-choice starter; accelerates Foxspirit Tag. Applies -DP.

skills.name: Bared Claws
skills.note: Alt starter; asymmetrical about the cancel.

skills.name: Foxspirit Tag
skills.note: Primary ranged spam; top priority when applying -DP.

skills.name: Nukduri Dance
skills.note: AP buff; only matters below AP cap. Good DPS regardless.

skills.name: Charmed
skills.note: Backup AP buff; skippable if over AP cap.

skills.name: Spirited Away
skills.note: Pair with Petal Play (Spirited Away -> Petal Play).

skills.name: Heavenly Return
skills.note: Optional; add with high attack speed (BSR / Shai buffs).

skills.name: Foxflare
skills.note: Optional in the loop; add with high attack speed.

skills.name: Lurking Claws
skills.note: Reposition for back-attacks; insert anywhere EXCEPT between Spirited Away -> Petal Play.

skills.name: Constricting Charm
skills.note: Out-of-spells filler; chains into Spirit Sparks.

skills.name: Soulflame
skills.note: Filler; chains into Flow: Hanpuri. COMMAND KEY UNVERIFIED (E per build guide) — confirm in skill window.

skills.name: Soulsnare
skills.note: Filler; chains into Flow: Hanpuri. COMMAND KEY UNVERIFIED (F per build guide) — confirm in skill window.

skills.name: Flow: Hanpuri
skills.note: Follow-up flow after Soulflame / Soulsnare. COMMAND UNVERIFIED — confirm in skill window.
